notes.title: Patch Notes 0.7 "God's Synthesis"
notes.notes:
Hello, fellow mercenaries!

This is Graham, the programmer, and as always thank you for playing our game! We are happy to announce the next update, "God's Synthesis", adding on a lot of exciting new content and fixing a few bugs.






1) New Stage - Abandoned Mines
A mine that has taken on a new form of life. You will encounter both the Phian and Aigam armies in this stage, as well as new types of enemies that have lived peacefully up until now. With the location of God's Synthesis finally confirmed, time is of the essence. Retrieve this artifact before either armies do!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/836e2b40e265401a39e9e6fea2bc2a179461b2b9.png"]




2) New Mercenary - Punk
Punk, the shapeshifting brawler, joins the Guild!

He relies on switching between his human and kangaroo stance to gain the advantage of any situation.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/7aa0d101be605a6936587231838f2800057256a9.gif"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/4fdb3a89ff6108041a3c77a294ee06afd606736e.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/4f1a09ada9dd11352d17512fa4226286865456fc.png"]
Left Hook / Bullet Kick (Auto Attack)
Level 1 Description:

Human: Short hook punch.

Damage: 100%

Kangaroo: Long wind kick

Damage: 75%   Pierce: 3

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/5dfde55af79fa8be34094bab4ec2411bba6c56d3.gif"]



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/fe28412f299bc6bb434f21a6588feceec03abd78.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/a7588bd9113c4623d599518147ed1efa64ef2b89.png"]
Stance Change (Active)
Level 1 Description:

Change between Human and Kangaroo Form.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/dbcc2f3006fc65d9304a8b64fa4d030c6abfede3.gif"]



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/0652129f5265fe12b5de62ac17285e0c734743c2.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/13923c7dac89655aea07f46678ab362a7bd045ab.png"]
Counter Punch / Battle Roar (Passive 1)
Level 1 Description:

Upon changing to Human: For 2s, unable to auto attack but can counter 1 attack.   Damage: 400%

Upon changing to Kangaroo: Roar, knocking back enemies.   Stun: 25%

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/096e15b49fa28ec1a074a54d75f42904e61c5564.gif"]



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/7ddcfeff098bfd7aa60500d6a5f2252f4ab4813d.png"]
Extreme Focus (Passive 2)
Level 1 Description:

Every 7th Auto Attack is a guaranteed critical hit.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/9817885ccf1a65da00ed3e553a77db7b84933283.png"]
Blast Beam (Ultimate)
Level 1 Description:

Focuses energy into a laser.

Damage: 50%   Duration: 5s

MVT SPD: -30%

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/fc280e45bdf20d4c7b0516744aeece446a7c7d71.gif"]






3) New Weapons, Armors, & Items
This time around, we added 2 weapons, 2 armor, and 4 items!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/6c598bab802630cbe3dc45968f7acf4560239bbc.png"]
Drill Shooter (Weapon)
Level 1 Description:

Shoots a drill that does continuous damage.

Damage: 70%   Pierce: 10

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/1ae2550e48f95d8396ee36fc30f673a4c1fd5ef4.gif"]



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/c9b901ea3bd6f3bd7d88a20dc22cefb1ff230809.png"]
Dead Man's Pickaxe (Weapon)
Level 1 Description:

Swings a pickaxe to the ground.

Damage: 70%

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/0106b4185c07194aac2f92d77b851eff88c8ee9a.gif"]



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/3adc43bbc608a3fe64e16be1db55bfd062303a51.png"]
Perun's Rock (Armor)
Level 1 Description:

DEF PEN: +10%



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/fdff8d501f98360a4163aa8d10f554db59b8c5f6.png"]
Veles' Shadow (Armor)
Level 1 Description:

Mitigate 1 hit.

CD: 120s

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/7be63c318e3e14acd8ab24ac9c6e17d3621f1de2.gif"]



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/9f30b0e7264b21c75fad6ef286a87741f3f86a20.png"]
Yggdrasil Branch (Item)
Lobs a seed which grows vines blocking enemies for 20s. The user is able to cross through the vines but at a reduced movement speed.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/bcc44c9cffda6f272cec55ef0ebd7dd9b75efdfe.gif"]



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/620063b1a9aaa2099f9a110d83d48ed1c679e120.png"]
Crystal Prism (Item)
Creates a barrier that makes you invincible for 3 seconds. Knocks back enemies upon breaking. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/e1eef1330257c2d6efee55179fe9802ed48b0f11.gif"]



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/5c675e4f92495e7e52d5a98fa0328c91bce33573.png"]
*Data Sword (Item)
Forward Slash.

Damage: 500 (Fixed)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/9bb13389de391839d2d1aad13107e59c7b263340.gif"]



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/ac434161de20b75bb76984dfa6264e3510f42407.png"]
*Philosopher Sword (Item)
Forward Slash Combo.

Damage: 500 (Fixed)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/50c10d8931f6717961764292e4d4e81dd24c80f6.gif"]



*Available only in the new Side Objective, Data Extraction.






4) New Side Objectives
New Side Objectives that will add more variety to your run!


Data Extraction
Help Maple extract data from enemies by defeating them using the "Data Sword"! It can be upgraded to the even more powerful, "Philosopher Sword", once you defeat 50 enemies!


Assassin
A deadly assassin has been hired to hunt you down. He employs sneaky attacks, making him tricky for those who are not ready.






5) Achievements
These new additions (except for "Data Sword" and "Philosopher Sword") can be obtained just by playing the "Abandoned Mines". Here's how to get them:



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/73073bcb14034362155faa24668517bee8f66eb0.png"]
I Tried 3:
Survive for 5 minutes in Abandoned Mines.

Reward: 250 CC



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/8c1ec713fe34dfd756b3053e3e1b2372fe1d1ce4.png"]
Getting Better 3:
Survive for 10 minutes in Abandoned Mines.

Reward: 400 CC



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/e149274d82b513c310ad238397c55dc4bc2e0e02.png"]
Veteran 3:
Survive for 15 minutes in Abandoned Mines.

Reward: Crystal Prism (Item)



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/92669db5a0c63b76e5546746615eaa8b4ef5325f.png"]
Mine Exploration:
Defeat 2000 enemies in Abandoned Mines..

Reward: Punk (Mercenary)



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/fba5e5a5118c9992781aeefd838a0b60d306386f.png"]
Mutated Abomination:
Defeat Slime Abomination.

Reward: Perun's Rock (Armor)



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/eb55ea76b123f7083fdafee9a8c2e9dced0a6730.png"]
Continuous Alteration:
Defeat Infected Mine Spider.

Reward: Veles' Shadow (Armor)



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/a74473b671dc43431e41700bf88c13cbd33ab3a4.png"]
Dragonslayer:
Defeat Infected Crystal Dragon.

Reward: Dead Man’s Pickaxe (Weapon)



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/6e7c943a454f94ccc517e7d97d4d7c45a559cd38.png"]
Guardian of the Mines
Defeat Golem.

Reward: Drill Shooter (Weapon)



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/efd6b1b487a9daeef7f18e7624f8633c04135a99.png"]
Otherworldly Entity:
Defeat Nameless Lifeform.

Reward: Yggdrasil Branch (Item)



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/16b136748184edd1497068002b9cfbf2eb716525.png"]
Mission Complete 3:
Complete the main objective in Abandoned Mines.

Reward: 1000 CC



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/bb3bb25d79f3abf00204a54ee5db852cead290be.png"]
Stage Clear 3:
Clear Abandoned Mines.

Reward: Abandoned Mines (Hard)



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/dd46e26fbfb98b1a34efdb106770cda395846907.png"]
Stage Clear Hard 3:
 Clear Abandoned Mines on Hard Mode.

Reward: 3000 CC






6) Miscellaneous
Updated Godot Engine from v3.5 to v3.6.

Added "Recommended Mercenary Rank" message for each Stage and Difficulty.

Added the ability to hide room names in the Pause Menu.

Added SFX when you pick up Kredits.

Added a demo video for J4CK-P0T Machine.

Added new Status Ailments (Please refer to "Help Menu" for description):

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/96ce071f5d4a0c35eca048d18703ca0d3b28c30a.png"] Stun

 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/eac39637d25f8b89f5d541a63d5e9da1012bbb83.png"] Corpse Explosion






7) Balance Changes

Survival
Frequency of side objectives changed from 2 minutes to 3 minutes.

Critical Miss (Mutation): Chance of missing decreased from \[15%, 30%] to \[5%, 10%].





[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/5d9d9e50a81104513089b85598fb5cbc74b21916.png"]
Pharaoh
Anubis' Blessing (Passive 2) Removed the condition to trigger this passive.




Weapons
Lowered the SFX of Partial Summoning (Overdrive) from -5db to -10db.




Phian Facility
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/3bcd6b29ffa456c03b302b446b9139587677a6ea.gif"]
- R-3X
HP: 40 -> 30


Aigam Fortress
The collisions that hide roofs of buildings have been increased.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/b887e528cff27bc15240a1f4c2e1432e72878384.gif"]
- Potoo
MVT SPD: 110 -> 90






8) Bug Fixes
Added "Gambler's Tea Set" in Character Select.

Gambler's "Slot Count" in Character Select is now correctly displayed.

Fixed a bug where the name for the weapon "Coin Launcher" was not displayed in the end results screen.

Maple dialogue will not trigger anymore when completing a main objective in Survival Mode.

Fixed a memory leak when entering Subspace for the first time in Survival Mode.

Strange Wanderer: fixed a bug where SFX abruptly ends when the bullet disappears.

Knight (Hard): Added the correct texture for their death particles.

Yuki Onna: No longer attacks you while in Subspace.

Fixed a visual bug on "Gravebot" death when they are frozen.

Fixed a few translation errors for Japanese.

Fixed a bug where players using the "Mob Index" could not go back to viewing the "Normal Variant" mobs, when switching back and forth between difficulties.





Thank you again for your support mercenaries, it means the world to us! The next update will not take as long as this one (Hopefully lol). We hope you enjoy!



Graham

notes.title: Version 0.5.1.5 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hello fellow mercenaries,

Hope you are liking the new game mode! Here are just some quick fixes.


 Changed the font for Usernames in the Survival Leaderboard so that both Japanese and English characters will show.
 Added a 60 second timer on Mob XPs to prevent later game runs from being performance heavy.
 Fixed a bug where Side Objectives did not shuffle correctly.

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.5 "Lady Luck's Survival"
notes.notes:
Hello, fellow mercenaries!
As always, thanks for playing our game!
I'm Graham, the programmer for Capybara Forge, and I get the privilege to tell you about this new update.  Sorry that this update took too long. It was solely because of me :(
Today I will be talking about the new additions for this upcoming update such as the new mode, index, new weapon/armor/item, balances, and key bindings!
Let's get to it right now!




1) New Mode - Survival
- In Survival Mode, you will have to survive as long as possible until you die or when the timer runs out. You can gain more time such as by killing mobs and completing objectives!
Your mercenary will be at a fixed rank depending on the difficulty.
Normal: Rank 5 | Hard: Rank 10
Survival Mode will be already unlocked but we recommend you to at least play through Standard Mode mode first.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/31c0c157fd69e0baf2eb7455dae6805fdaa5416d.png"]
Survival Mode (Mechanics)
Mechanics vary compared to Standard Mode as completing the main objective will immediately spawn the Final Boss; where as in Standard Mode, the door to the Subspace opens.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/23c77b4a952c24c2ef49c0daefae2a2e20e06ec7.png"]Not only this but, you will be able to proceed to the next stage after beating the Final Boss and leaving the Subspace! As there are only 2 stages, you will loop back to the the first stage after beating the second.

There will also be new mechanics unique to Survival Mode!

- Perks
Perks can be purchased with Kredits that give you a further edge in battle. 3 random perks will be available every stage. Interact with the book at the Subspace Bar to have a look!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/a1f446410a636910183911a839c1ca1d4c9b0df3.png"]

- Weapon Upgrades
Your overdriven weapons can be further enhanced by using the anvil on the bottom left of Subspace. Remember that you must overdrive a weapon first in order to upgrade them.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/d3cb602f8e3b60c0be3458c85e78931b83b7fa27.png"]

- Mutations
Every time you enter a stage a new mutation appears! They will stay indefinitely every run and more will come to increase the difficulty of a Survival run.
When getting an existing mutation it will further increase the effect of that mutation too!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/96d1380ad162d621867c24a1a9f4da99af65244d.png"]To look at the active Perks and Mutations, you can look at them in the Pause Menu under the "Perks, Mutations" Button.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/9af12825a73d4a2a6c09fe8644223963d97b8a8d.png"]

- Leaderboard
Compete against yourself or globally! Your Survival runs get stored on the Personal and Global Leaderboards if you get a high score!
It will save your Steam username, score, time, mercenary, and the overdriven skill if any!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/cba3e2da58d0872488bfb687fdb58270a2bf3886.png"]That's all we have to talk about for Survival Mode.
We will be tweaking/adding more Perks and Mutations as we keep on updating the game so hopefully you will be able to enjoy this mode every update.
Also, when a new stage comes out, we will be adding that stage to Survival Mode as well.





2) New Mercenary - Gambler
Gambler, the crazed, gambling eccentric joins the guild!
Her playstyle depends on luck but she has the utility to defend herself if she needs it!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/9e8446121a14d2f97323b677ab792831e7c1346f.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/fc1da5246b01b5aa35f0d0970392bd7e6e7f1c5c.png"] 
Fated Die (Auto Attack)
- Level 1 Description:
-- Throws a die.
-- Damage: 1 - 6 (Fixed)
-- Different effects can occur depending on damage.
-- On crit, throw 2 dice.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/8a6532a9c44c87e0ddd218e91cdb926543f47bfa.gif"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/7375c876bd8c32e2e2c4534e7900f247b8a82aa4.png"] 
Royal Draw (Active)
- Level 1 Description:
-- Throws a random card. Inflicts a random effect depending on card drawn.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/3d4922c726292ab714f12a36ad8e167b1f058007.gif"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/b5abe968fee8a366d0ff7a46e40d2bb005127075.png"] 
Adrenaline (Passive 1)
-- Level 1 Description:
--- MVT SPD: +20% for 5s (when Auto Attack crits)



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/0f3a345fd7f94d49e896f36249645f6a72a319b2.png"] 
Karma (Passive 2)
- Level 1 Description:
-- When Gambler gets hit, drop dice around her.
-- CD: 30s

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/646a7ea9c2a7e7c456126b6554f0e0c97ab806b2.gif"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/60eaacfa9f33d72bfefd5a77d9d363bde40830e9.png"] 
Roulette of Fortune (Ultimate)
- Level 1 Description:
-- Gambler bets on a color by activating the Ultimate again in which a giant roulette crashes down. 
-- If bet is won, activate the certain effect corresponding to the color.
-- Red = ATK: +20% & DEF: +5% (30s)   Black = Explosion (Damage: 300%)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/832f644377282c1c23927089adac1aa86c8533d9.gif"]Gambler was the one of the first mercenaries that I designed but due to her complexity we held it back until this update lol.
We hope you will like the new mercenary as much as we enjoyed making her!
Also as a side note: Her theme song is really cool too once you get to it!





3) New Weapon, Armor, & Item
We added 1 new weapon, 1 armor, and 1 item that goes along with the theme of Gambler!



 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/fcb8bbd5d0dd8a075c5718d1c97feb1016c2c47e.png"] 
Strange Wanderer (Weapon)
- Level 1 Description: 
-- Shoot an ordinary bullet.
-- Damage: 100%
-- Chance to summon the Strange Wanderer (5%)
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/6ac1950acdc17ab0519684137eb9cedb8608b2a9.gif"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/5daa4e7d7d86388a60e740715bb1853c067e4db4.png"] 
Jackpot Machine (Armor)
- Level 1 Description:
-- When hit, a slot machine falls down from above and knocks enemies back.
-- Will either roll Kredits, Power Ups, or Food.
-- Damage: 100 (Fixed)



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/597c9021f19f1772669f6f21348fc3c762ee93d9.png"] 
Coin Launcher (Item)
- Use Kredits as ammo to shoot.
- The amount of Kredits use will range from 10 to 1250.
- Damage: 150 (Fixed)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/a55bb7232c3220d8665d6ff29df0f091e5052352.gif"]



4) Achievements
We added 8 new achievements! Some of the rewards unlock the new additions to this update.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/e90cbeb9a39b2749dc01611e8cf727ae50fe3ec6.png"]
More Power:
- Upgrade an Overdriven Weapon for the first time in Survival Mode.
-- Reward: Strange Wanderer (Weapon)


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/c04ee7d5fd17a4da666d614896707b64c160d64e.png"]
First Drink:
- Buy a Perk for the first time in Survival Mode.
-- Reward: Jackpot Machine (Armor)


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/62a06fae30f226d0304da6dd5806447d70792641.png"]
Survive 1:
- Survive for 10 minutes in Survival Mode.
-- Reward: 500 CC


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/8ee0ded116757ed4123a14a6b9633136eab327ae.png"] 
Survive 2:
- Survive for 20 minutes in Survival Mode.
-- Reward: Coin Launcher (Item)


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/e1d5946a6a1c2e41fdf99d362b27f5f94975a147.png"]
Survive 3:
- Survive for 30 minutes in Survival Mode.
-- Reward: 1000 CC


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/134162aeb6cd9855e33aa5a189e6a72827134101.png"]
Lucky Day?:
- Unlock “Strange Wanderer”, “Jackpot Machine”, and “Coin Launcher.”
-- Reward: Gambler (Mercenary)


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/4af41735b206cef6d5a95941c2822760bdeee462.png"]
2K Gambler:
- Defeat 2000 enemies with Gambler.
-- Reward: 500 CC


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/40075b2479d908b13e5105ddb555b340d8593b6d.png"]
Gambler Clear:
- Clear 1 mission with Gambler.
-- Reward: 500 CC

We added these achievements as an incentive to play this new mode. These achievements should already be shown in the Steam achievements.





5) Index
We finally implemented the Index!
Here you can view the Mercenaries, Weapons, and more that you have unlocked. An overdriven version of a weapon can also be viewed only if you have overdriven it once.
Mobs that have been defeated can also be view here too.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/faba1ae18d0c6d8dd32debd0f4636620da8e71bb.png"]

6) Balance Changes


Mercenaries
We increased the Stats of all Mercenaries when they rank up to give them a better feel that they are stronger than before.
The numbers below represent the corresponding stat for each rank. The max rank is 10 and each mercenary starts at rank 0.
Ex: Rank 0/Rank 1/Rank 2/Rank 3/.../Rank 10


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/09457192dae158dba27117ae7577a0f8dc4b17af.png"]

- HP: 70/74/78/82/86/90/94/98/102/106/110 -> 70/76/82/88/94/100/106/112/118/124/130
- ATK: 25/27/29/31/33/37/39/41/43/45 -> 25/32/34/36/38/40/42/44/46/48/50

- AOE: 0%/2%/4% -> 0%/5%/10%

notes.title: New Patch for Demo!
notes.notes:
Hello Mercenaries!

Thank you so much for playing our game! It means the world to us that actual people would try this game out!

This patch includes balances changes to all playable mercenaries and mobs due to overhauling how defense works including some bug fixes that were found ever since the release of this demo.

Version 0.18.6.1
Purpose of Overhauling the DEF Stat:
There would be moments in the game where the player would deal 1 damage to an enemy because of their low ATK compared to a mob's high DEF. We want to make sure that even dealing low damage is a viable option as it will lead to more interesting strategies.

Major Changes:

 Defense Stat is now calculated as a percent instead of a flat amount.
 All mobs have increased HP.
 All mobs have decreased ATK due to DEF overhaul.
 A Weapon, Muses' Whisper,  has lower damage.
 An Overdriven Weapon, Kur's Fang (which was call Tiamat before being overdriven), has increased damage.
 BattleTOP has higher DEF & MVT SPD.
 Karambit has lower ATK. Has higher HP & MVT SPD.
 Old Man has slightly lower HP.
 BattleTOP's Overdriven Auto Attack has increased damage and can now inflict burn.
 Karambit's Overdriven Auto Attack has lower damage.
 Burn Ailment ticks twice as fast.
 Harder to achieve S-Ranks after completing the mission.


Bug Fixes:

 Fixed a bug when teleporting to the Server Room, the minimap does not update to display the correct location.
 Fixed a bug where a player cannot reach a Care Package because it is in a place where the player cannot travel towards. When the Care Package is in this state, it will now slide towards the player until it is in reach for the player to get.
 Fixed a bug where a SFX would constantly still play in the Care Package Menu.
 Fixed a bug where a button on the Settings would still be able to be pressed when transitioning out of it.
 Fixed a bug where the Help Button on Pause was still clickable even when on Settings.
